name: Homelab
author: dadoux01
description: Homelab assistant over SSH: hardware monitoring, Proxmox VE (VMs, containers, storage, backups), Docker containers, services (Home Assistant, Jellyfin, Navidrome, Sonarr, Radarr, Prowlarr, qBittorrent, Transmission, Pi-hole, AdGuard Home), alerts with desktop notifications, image and package update checks, links and a one-click SSH terminal.

barWidget.description: Hardware monitoring, Docker containers, links and SSH for your homelab hosts.

schema.label: Hosts file
schema.description: JSON file listing your hosts. Leave empty for ~/.config/omarchy/homelab.json.

schema.label: Secrets file
schema.description: Where service API keys are stored (mode 600). Leave empty for ~/.config/omarchy/homelab-secrets.json.

schema.label: Desktop notifications
schema.description: Notify when a host goes down, a container stops or crashes, a disk fills up, a service reports a problem, or updates are available.

schema.label: Background check interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often hosts are checked while the panel is closed.

schema.label: Update check interval (hours)
schema.description: Image, package and service update checks. 0 disables automatic checks.
